name: LumenicMenu
author: LensError
description: Replaces the ChilloutVR Main Menu and Quick Menu with a native Rust UI built on Lumenic. Includes live settings search, Quick Menu pinning, UILib/UIExpansionKit mod bridges, and independent menu toggles.
changelog: Revamped Group Management view (individual role picker, mass set to Member for Trial/non-Member users, member search/role filters/pagination, and group privacy settings), added World Pin to Quick Menu, upgraded World Active Instance cards with player previews and clickable card body, added Instance Details shortcut on User Details, added VR controller hover haptics, added Quick Menu bottom bar scroll-back arrow, matched Messages top bar button sizing to Discover, filtered hidden internal CVR settings, and fixed extension TextInput/Slider/VR keyboard handling.
